identity.title: Define governance context v1 as evidence-backed opaque references

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Define the minimal source-neutral context carried through evidence/projection: principal_ref, workflow_ref, invocation_ref, policy_snapshot_ref, plus provenance/evidence linkage. All fields are optional unless a producer contract explicitly requires them. Dependency: 8041.clarify-governance-control-boundary.
human_pressure.why_now: Identity and policy snapshot are core governance concepts, but implementing services before the evidence contract is stable would repeat the old gateway mistake. Freeze a small contract first.
do_not_misread: This repository is the canonical Ailuros governance runtime; do not apply cleanup assumptions from the legacy MCP Gateway repository.
Identity references are governance provenance, not login/authentication/session management.
Approval and budget in this batch are evidence-backed records/projections, not workflow/payment services.
Do not turn Ailuros into an agent executor or coding harness.
red_lines: No database migration or runtime enforcement.

machine_core.goal: Create a normative governance-context contract that can be emitted by EverRun and other producers without importing Ailuros code.
red_lines: No database migration or runtime enforcement.
invariants: Depends on: 8041.clarify-governance-control-boundary. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Opaque refs are governance facts, not authority by themselves.
Possession of principal_ref or policy_snapshot_ref never implies allow.
contracts: governance_context_v1 = principal_ref? + workflow_ref? + invocation_ref? + policy_snapshot_ref? + provenance/evidence refs
failure_semantics: Missing governance-context evidence remains unknown/absent; it is never inferred as allowed, approved, within budget or clean.
Explicit denial/violation evidence is preserved with evidence refs.
Derived control-context state remains rebuildable from immutable evidence.
Producer-native values remain preserved alongside normalized projections.

steps.title: Define opaque identity refs
details: principal_ref identifies the actor/principal asserted by evidence.
workflow_ref groups governed work without defining workflow execution semantics.
invocation_ref identifies one governed invocation/request/action boundary.
Refs are strings/opaque identifiers; no global identity directory is required.

steps.title: Define policy snapshot ref
details: policy_snapshot_ref identifies the immutable policy/version/hash used for a decision when known.
A ref may point to producer-native policy material; Ailuros need not store full policy bodies in every evidence package.

steps.title: Define provenance rules
details: Every normalized context fact must retain source pointer/evidence refs.
Contradictory refs are preserved as inconsistency, not silently reconciled.

steps.title: Extend runtime evidence contract additively
details: Add optional governance_context to the package/event guidance without breaking existing producers.
Do not make EverRun planner/coder/judge vocabulary mandatory.

acceptance: Identity refs do not require authentication/session infrastructure.
Existing producers without governance_context remain valid and project unknown/absent context.

must_check: Every context fact is evidence/provenance linked.
No source-specific mandatory field is introduced.
reject_if: The contract requires a policy engine service or full policy body replication.
EverRun-specific role/pack fields become mandatory core schema.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed/approved/within-budget.
